part.text:
Done. I implemented the solution in `paasio.go` and all tests in `paasio_test.go` pass, including under `-race`.

What I added:
- **`readCounter`** — wraps an `io.Reader`, tracks total bytes read (`n`) and call count (`nops`) behind a mutex. `Read()` delegates to the wrapped reader, then records the result; `ReadCount()` returns the totals.
- **`writeCounter`** — same pattern for an `io.Writer`.
- **`readWriteCounter`** — embeds both counters so it satisfies `ReadWriteCounter`.
- Constructors `NewReadCounter`, `NewWriteCounter`, `NewReadWriteCounter`.

Key detail: each `Read`/`Write` increments `nops` on every call and adds the returned byte count, while the mutex guarantees `ReadCount`/`WriteCount` are consistent even under the concurrent tests. I only touched `paasio.go` — no changes to the test file or new files.
